From logo to delivered, in three steps

Pick your gear

Browse the catalog or tell us the job — we'll spec the right styles, colors, and decoration method for your budget.

2

Send your logo

We digitize your art and send a proof before anything gets stitched or pressed. No surprises on press day.

3

We produce & deliver

Embroidery, screen print, DTG, and DTF — all in-house in Milton, WA. Most orders ship in 7–10 business days.

Decoration pricing

Three quick questions, one live price — it includes the garment and decoration, straight from our pricing system.

1 How many do you need?

Bigger runs unlock lower per-piece prices.

2 Where does your design go?

Screen print only — counts for the front and back.
High-visibility striping — adds $2.00/piece per print location.

3 Pick a look

Price shown is garment + decoration included — not a decoration-only add-on.
